video-processed.eventDescription: One video downloaded, analyzed and delivered with its metadata (any length up to the limit). Failed videos are free.

frame.eventDescription: One frame image saved (JPEG, PNG or WebP). A contact sheet counts as one frame.

scene-minute.eventDescription: One started minute of video analyzed for scene changes (scene mode only; a 10 min 20 s video is 11 minutes). Videos above 1080p count once per 1080p-sized area: 1440p 2x, 4K 4x.

audio-or-gif.eventTitle: Copied audio track or GIF clip
audio-or-gif.eventDescription: The audio track when copied without re-encoding (e.g. AAC to M4A), or each 5 s of GIF at 480x480 px and 10 fps (the default GIF of a landscape video is 1). GIFs from videos above 1080p count 2x (1440p) or 4x (4K).

audio-minute.eventDescription: One started minute of video whose audio track is re-encoded to the chosen format (e.g. AAC to MP3 or Opus). Copied tracks are billed as one audio-or-gif event instead.
